descricao: Screenshot of the Home page of the public Streamlit app (English), used on the project page as the call to the demo. It contains no number that is not already shown by the app, which reads every number from results/ and data/processed/*.meta.json.
ferramenta: Google Chrome (headless, installed on the author's machine)
pos_processamento: Pillow: crop to (0, 0, 1280, 750) to drop the Streamlit Cloud corner badges, quantize to 128 colours (median cut), PNG optimize
nota: Not regenerated by docs/scripts/build_site.py (it needs the network); the builder only checks that this file exists, is below 300 KB and still has the sha256 above. To refresh it, repeat the command, the crop and the quantization, then update both sha256 fields.
